title: Polarization of Autonomous Generative AI Agents Under Echo Chambers

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent discussions on subjective topics (e.g., granting AI human rights) using social interaction modeling to create echo chambers, and analyzing how agent stances and reasoning transition toward extreme values over multiple turns.

Comparing the final converged stance distributions of AI agents discussing identical career-choice topics in different languages (English vs. Japanese) to observe differing societal norms embedded in the models' training data.
